_A_TABLE_GROUP_FILTERS_DEFAULT_HIDE_DESC: Filters with main: true or alwaysVisible: true are always shown. The other filters are hidden until the user opens them.
_A_TABLE_GROUP_FILTERS_INITIAL_MODEL_DES: model-filters sets the values of the filters when the table is shown.
_A_TABLE_GROUP_FILTERS_INIT_SAVED_DESCRI: filter.filtersSaved passes filter sets that were saved before, the user can apply them at once.
_A_TABLE_GROUP_FILTERS_SAVE_DESCRIPTION_: With filter.canSave: true the user can save the current filter values under a name and apply them later.
